newsitem.title: THAILAND: Two Japanese held in Thailand on vice charges.
newsitem.headline: Two Japanese held in Thailand on vice charges.

text.p: Two Japanese men were arrested at Bangkok airport on the charge of conspiring to send Thai women to Japan to become prostitutes, Thai immigration police said on Tuesday.
The two, both from Tokyo, were arrested on Monday along with two Thai women as they were about to board a flight to Seoul en route to Japan, the chief of the airport's immigration police said.
He said the two men were believed to be members of a ring which has been luring Thai women to become prostitutes in Japan. The two Thai women were detained for carrying falsified documents.
If found guilty, the men face a maximum sentence of five years in prison, police said.
Women's rights groups estimate more than 60,000 Thai women are working as prostitutes in Japan.
